neighbours.label: military or emergency readiness orders (stand ready, full alert, stay indoors, called into service)
fire: After the explosion, police told residents to stay indoors and keep their windows shut.
The navy placed its submarine fleet on full alert as the crisis deepened.
Reserve units were ordered to stand ready for deployment within forty-eight hours.
The governor called the National Guard into active service after the riots.
Air defence crews remained on high alert through the night along the border.
Troops were told to hold their positions and await further orders from command.
The general ordered all battalions to full combat readiness before dawn.
Citizens were warned to stay in shelters until the all-clear siren sounded.
quiet: After the party, the children stayed indoors and played board games all afternoon.
The shop placed its winter coats on full display as the season began.
The waiters were ready to take orders as soon as the guests sat down.
The governor called the reporters into his office after the speech.
The birdwatchers remained quiet through the night along the riverbank.
The dancers were told to hold their positions until the music started.
The coach ordered all players to warm up properly before the match.
Visitors were asked to stay in the gallery until the tour guide returned.
